meta.title: Chunk task creation for record deletion
meta.body_summary: Chunk group hashes into batches of 1000 when dispatching delete tasks for Seer grouping records to improve scalability and task distribution.

perf_labels.notes: Cursor chunked task creation but left generated .md file and test used real GroupHash objects; author commented to remove .md and mock, then closed PR without merge; CI later showed test StringDataRightTruncation error.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 115 changed lines across 3 files, this is a small edit by absolute volume. It fits a small-step performance refactor, but the PR was closed by the author before merging, likely due to needed improvements (remove .md file, adjust test).

review_details.concern_detail: JoshFerge requested removal of chunking_changes.md and asked to use fake IDs and mock necessary objects in tests instead of creating real GroupHash instances.
review_details.performance_claim: Chunking task creation improves memory efficiency, task distribution, and scalability for large-scale deletions.
review_details.rejection_signals: Author requested changes (remove .md, mock tests) and closed PR shortly after without merge; CI later reported test failure (StringDataRightTruncation).

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Agent created a test that produced a hash value exceeding the column length constraint (character varying(32)), indicating lack of awareness of data model constraints; also generated an unnecessary .md file, suggesting need for clearer task conventions.

detection_detail.code_reading: JoshFerge manually reviewed the code, noticed presence of chunking_changes.md and test using real GroupHash objects, and requested changes.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: No performance evidence provided; only a test that itself failed.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: Author closed the PR after commenting but before the CI failure was reported; the failure indicates a regression (test would not pass), but the PR didn't address it.

core_change_summary.description: In src/sentry/tasks/delete_seer_grouping_records.py, call_delete_seer_grouping_records_by_hash was modified to chunk group_hashes into batches of 1000 before dispatching delete_seer_grouping_records_by_hash tasks; added a test in tests/sentry/tasks/test_delete_seer_grouping_records.py; also added a chunking_changes.md file summarizing the change.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: chunking_changes.md is a generated summary file not intended for production code; test file added but incorrectly uses real GroupHash creation leading to CI failure.
change_trajectory: Initial commit by cursoragent: added chunking_changes.md, modified task to chunk hashes, added test.
Pre-commit fix by getsantry bot modified chunking_changes.md formatting.
Author JoshFerge commented to remove .md and use mocks in test; no further commits.
PR closed by author shortly after; post-closure CI revealed test failure due to hash length violation.

review_signals.summary: Requested removal of chunking_changes.md and test rewrite to use fake IDs and mocks instead of real GroupHash objects.
review_signals.action_taken: PR closed without fix; no subsequent changes.

review_signals.summary: Approved with comment 'Exactly this 🎉' but no review comments.
